title: RT30019: Sci And Tech. Rubber And Rubber Like Materials
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introductory concepts of macromolecule. Introduction to different rubbers
ÃÂ¢ÃÂÃÂ their structures and related properties (Tg, crystallinity,
viscoelastic effects), rubber vis-ÃÂÃÂ -vis other materials, Natural rubber.
Manufacture of synthetic rubbers, Properties and characterization of rubbers
(structural, mol wt, thermal, mechanical, electrical, optical). Compounding
ingredients used in rubber (vulcanizing agents, accelerators, antioxidants,
fillers, special purpose ingredients). Vulcanization of rubber (chemistry and
technology). Mixing of rubber and blends. Physical and chemical testing of
rubbers. Design of rubber compounds for particular end use. (Tyre, hose,
belting, seal etc.). Manufacturing concepts of rubber products.
